invariants.text: AuditLog.customer_id must reference an existing Customer.id
AuditLog.log_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Customer.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Each audit log entry must contain the operation type, the customer_id, and the timestamp.
The audit log must include a record for every customer operation, regardless of whether the operation succeeds or fails.
The customer_id in the audit log must match the id of the customer involved in the operation.
The timestamp in the audit log must reflect the exact moment the operation is performed.
Whenever a customer is deleted, an audit log entry must be generated with the operation set to 'delete', the customer_id set to the customer's id, and the timestamp set to the current time.
Whenever a customer is updated, an audit log entry must be generated with the operation set to 'update', the customer_id set to the customer's id, and the timestamp set to the current time.

Whenever a new customer is created, an audit log entry must be generated with the operation set to 'create', the customer_id set to the newly created customer's id, and the timestamp set to the current time.
